Name: Cute Witch
Author: 7Kana
Description:
Witch with no green face and no hooked nose, who is better suited to be the ex-wife of Rasmodius. She replaces the fluttering witch in the game.
Cute Witch pair well with my portrait and sprite [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30437]Esmeralda the Witch Portrait and Sprite[/url]

Installation:
Unzip it and paste it into Stardew Valley's Mods folder, to uninstall it simply delete this mod.
Enjoy! <3
